end of heading, Information for patients, level 2

Spire Wellesley Hospital are excited to announce the arrival of new MRI and CT scanners in 2025. Works will begin on 18 August 2025 and are expected to last around 9 months. During this time, a portion of the carpark will no longer be in use. We apologise for the disruption this may cause.

Spire Wellesley Hospital takes pride in providing a high standard of care and some of the latest medical technology. With a full multidisciplinary medical team, you can get fast access to consultations with specialists. We offer a wide range of treatments that are personalised to you and as much aftercare as you clinically need.

heading, How to get to us, level 2

Southend is only 20 miles from the M25 and Spire Wellesley Hospital is a couple of miles from the town centre, just off the A127. We are a short taxi ride from the train station, which has a fast and regular connection to London Liverpool Street.

end of heading, Travel instructions, level 2
Follow the A127 towards Southend on Sea.

As you approach central Southend you will reach a main set of traffic lights which has a public footbridge crossing the carriageway. The traffic lights are located on a crossroads, which has a Toby Carvery public house located across the lights and is on your left.
Proceed across the traffic lights and at the next roundabout go straight across (second exit) following the signs for Shoebury A1159 (A13).
Follow the road and at the next roundabout (approximately half a mile) proceed straight across (second exit).
You will then approach a third roundabout at which you need to take the first exit signposted to Waitrose, B&Q and Spire Wellesley Hospital.
Spire Wellesley Hospital is located immediately on your right.
There is ample short and long-stay free parking on site.
